Codex completed the registered correctness checks at exact `bd3858cac9a306aa3b8d4729cf059959a7c70885`. **All commands exited zero; candidate is ready for the single registered timing comparison.**

- Verify passed with AddressSanitizer and optimized WMO, comparing complete prime arrays for every limit −2…2,048, larger square boundaries, one million and ten million.
- ExtraVerify passed with ASAN: every limit 2,049…30,000, 500 deterministic random limits, 1,561 prime-square boundaries, **11,382 wide alignment/group/tail limits**, and **3,654 sparse double-group/cleanup limits**.
- PhaseVerify passed with WMO: **53,015 partial/full checks over 2,305 limits**, allocation zeroing and complete raw-buffer equality including padding against the unchanged B reference.

The generator and independently reviewed assembly gate passed earlier. No source changed afterward. No ExtraVerify WMO or PhaseVerify ASAN run was added to this local bracket. Full commands, exit statuses, hashes and assembly evidence will be published with the results.

The reviewed timing wrapper also preserves partial output and terminates its owned child process group before releasing the lock on execution errors. The shared upstream-output restoration is protected by its lock. Independent static review found no remaining orchestration blockers. No timing has started yet.
